# lmw watch run

Check the watches that are due once, and notify (for cron)

### Synopsis

Check the watches that are due, send what they found to your channels, and exit.
Run it from cron or a scheduled task instead of `lmw daemon`.

```
lmw watch run [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --all         check every watch, due or not
  -h, --help        help for run
      --no-notify   only print what is new; send nothing
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
